message: Missing/Undetermined Ct values remain missing and are never replaced with zero; missingness may be nonrandom.
Normalization assumes one stable reference gene and equal amplification efficiencies; Ct values alone do not validate these assumptions.
Incomplete normalized observations were excluded from the fit; missingness may be nonrandom and is not evidence of no change.
Technical wells were averaged within sample and gene before normalization; fit n counts sample-level observations, and n_subjects counts distinct biological subjects.
